vm_mc4_join_db1
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc4_join_db1 AS SELECT d.no_ktp, d.nama_lengkap, b.penghasilan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d JOIN bansos_db.master_penduduk b ON d.no_ktp = b.nikk;

model.name: vm_mc4_join_db2
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc4_join_db2 AS SELECT d.no_ktp, d.nama_lengkap, b.penghasilan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d JOIN bansos_db.master_penduduk b ON d.no_ktpp = b.nik;

model.name: vm_mc4_join_dtks
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc4_join_dtks AS SELECT d.no_ktp, d.nama_lengkap, t.desil_kesejahteraan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d JOIN dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat t ON d.no_ktp = t.no_ktp_kepalaa;

model.name: vm_mc4_join_bpjs
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc4_join_bpjs AS SELECT d.no_ktp, bj.kelas_layanan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d JOIN bpjs_db.peserta bj ON d.no_ktp = bj.no_ktpp;

model.name: vm_mc4_join_three
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc4_join_three AS SELECT d.no_ktp, t.status_kemiskinan, bj.kelas_layanan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk ds LEFT JOIN dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat t ON ds.no_ktp = t.no_ktpp_kepala LEFT JOIN bpjs_db.peserta bj ON ds.no_ktp = bj.no_ktp;

model.name: vm_mc_ok_bansos
vm_mc_ok_dukcapil
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc_ok_dukcapil AS SELECT no_ktp, nama_lengkap, tgl_lahir, jenis_kelamin, agama, status_perkawinan, pendidikan_terakhir FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk;

model.name: vm_mc_ok_dtks
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc_ok_dtks AS SELECT kpm_id, no_ktp_kepala, no_kk, desil_kesejahteraan, status_kemiskinan, sumber_data FROM dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat;

model.name: vm_mc_ok_bpjs
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc_ok_bpjs AS SELECT peserta_id, no_ktp, nama_peserta, kelas_layanan, jenis_kepesertaan, status_aktif FROM bpjs_db.peserta;

model.name: vm_mc_ok_join
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc_ok_join AS SELECT d.no_ktp, d.nama_lengkap, d.tgl_lahir, b.penghasilan, b.status_hidup FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d JOIN bansos_db.master_penduduk b ON d.no_ktp = b.nik;

model.name: vm_mc_ok_terpadu
model.metadata: CREATE VIEW v_mc_ok_terpadu AS SELECT d.no_ktp, d.nama_lengkap, t.status_kemiskinan, t.desil_kesejahteraan, bj.kelas_layanan, bj.jenis_kepesertaan FROM dukcapil_db.penduduk d LEFT JOIN dtks_db.keluarga_penerima_manfaat t ON d.no_ktp = t.no_ktp_kepala LEFT JOIN bpjs_db.peserta bj ON d.no_ktp = bj.no_ktp;
